verdict.rationale: Datadog's API docs refer to an official Datadog API collection for Postman, which is a machine-readable description of the API, though not OpenAPI. However, a probe found no OpenAPI/Swagger file at any common path (all returned 404), and the markdown version of the API page is not a structured spec. Missing for 10: a documented downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec file, an explicit download location for the Postman collection, and hands-on confirmation that a spec can be retrieved.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: add your Datadog API and Application key values to the **Collection variables** of the Datadog API collection
